parts.title: Vægtklasse ved pligtig DM-deltagelse for landsholdsløftere
Præstationskrav ved pligtig DM-deltagelse for landsholdsløftere

ops.reason: Besides the duty itself to take part in DM, the rule holds two separate decisions of the same date: the free choice of weight class at the mandatory DM and the performance requirement (real attempt at 80 % of VM lifts), each of which can change independently.
The decision is an EPF/IPF requirement that head coaches sign a responsibility document at IPF and EPF championships, an international requirement binding DSF rather than a DSF national-team rule.

Both rules require Danish lifters competing internationally to use only IPF-approved equipment; the 2015 decision restates that requirement and only adds that the Danish special rule does not apply abroad.
